card.title: Nintendo Switch

claims.statement: Switch parts: M92T36 USB-C PMIC, PI3USB30532ZLEX audio/video switch, BQ24193 charger, MAX17050 fuel gauge, BCM4356XKUBG Wi-Fi, MAX77620AEWJ+T main PMIC, MAX77621AEWI+T CPU/RAM PMIC, P15123CT USB-C fuse, DX07BN24JA2R1300 USB-C connector, Molex 503300-5310 LCD FPC (not Lite).
Diode packs (TPD2E1B06DRLR) on some revisions can be removed without affecting function.
A blue screen is traditionally eMMC failure but can be RAM or CPU, often with a bent unit; if pressing on the RAM chips gets it to the Nintendo logo, the RAM may need a reball.
Check the known CPU capacitors for shorts first; if shorted, consensus is the CPU is dead.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
